title: L1->L2 migration redemption has no spent-marker and uses += accounting, allowing unbounded replay of a single proof/signature to mint unbacked deposits, stalk and roots
description: redeemDepositsAndInternalBalances() is the permissionless L2 endpoint that re-issues an L1 contract's silo deposits, stalk and roots onto L2. It verifies a Merkle proof against a static MERKLE_ROOT and an EIP-712 signature (signed on L1) but never records that a given (owner, leaf, signature) has been redeemed. After verification it writes per-account deposits, then calls setStalk(reciever, accountStalk, ownerRoots) which does `s.accts[reciever].stalk += accountStalk` and `s.accts[reciever].roots += accountRoots`. Because there is no nonce/spent mapping and stalk/roots accumulate with +=, the exact same calldata (owner, reciever, deposits, internalBalances, ownerRoots, proof, deadline, signature) can be resubmitted any number of times until `deadline`. Each replay re-adds accountStalk and ownerRoots, and re-writes the deposit entries. The proof and signature are fully public (visible in the original L2 transaction calldata / mempool), so no privileged material is required to replay. This is a cross-chain bug because the authorization artifact (the L1-signed permit + L1 Merkle leaf) is intended to be consumed exactly once on L2 but the L2 contract enforces no consume-once semantics.
impact: An attacker observes any legitimate migration redemption (or front-runs one), then replays the identical calldata repeatedly. stalk and roots are inflated without backing on each replay; stalk and roots are the governance vote weight and the divisor/numerator for earned-Bean (mint) distribution. Unbounded inflation of stalk/roots dilutes all honest holders' yield and grants the replayer effectively unlimited governance weight and an outsized claim on every future sunrise mint — protocol insolvency / unbacked share issuance. Critical under Immunefi v2.2 (direct theft of protocol value / unbacked minting of value-bearing shares).

ite.intent: Mint unbacked stalk/roots and re-credit deposits to a chosen L2 address by reusing a single L1 migration authorization
ite.technique: Replay public proof+signature calldata before deadline; setStalk uses += so each replay accumulates; no spent/nonce mapping exists
ite.evasion: MerkleProof.verify and ECDSA.recover are stateless and pass identically on every call; the contract performs no idempotency check

ice_chain.corrupted_state: s.accts[reciever].stalk and s.accts[reciever].roots (incremented on every replay), plus re-written s.accts[reciever].deposits[depositId]
ice_chain.consumer_function: LibSilo earned-Bean (mint) distribution and governance vote-weight reads of s.accts[].stalk/.roots
ice_chain.impact: Unbacked stalk/roots -> stolen share of every future Bean mint and unbounded governance weight -> protocol insolvency
ice_chain.exploit_path: observe a redeem tx -> resubmit identical calldata N times before deadline -> setStalk += accumulates stalk/roots each time -> downstream mint/governance consumers read the inflated balances
